title: Highlights of Vietnam Group Tour
alt: Titop island beach and viewpoint in Halong Bay
transport: Two domestic flights, coach travel and guided tours

stops.name: Ho Chi Minh City
stops.subtitle: Saigon and Cu Chi
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 4★ · Four star hotel in District 3, with a garden pool

activities.name: Saigon half day sightseeing
activities.match: Half-Day Ho Chi Minh Sightseeing Tour
activities.description: The Reunification Palace, the old post office and Notre Dame cathedral, then the war remnants museum and the Ben Thanh market.

activities.name: Cu Chi tunnels tour
activities.description: The tunnel network north west of the city, with the trapdoors, the kitchens and a crawl through a widened section of the original shafts.

program.name: Ho Chi Minh City
program.description: Two nights in the south, with the city and the Cu Chi tunnels on a single full day.

stops.name: Da Nang
stops.subtitle: Hoi An and Ba Na Hills
stops.accom: 1 night · Breakfast · Standard room · 4★ · Four star hotel across the road from My Khe beach

activities.name: Hoi An walking tour with a boat ride
activities.description: The Japanese covered bridge, the Sa Huynh museum and the Phuoc Kien assembly hall on foot, then a boat out onto the river.

program.name: Da Nang
program.description: The flight to the central coast and an afternoon on foot in the old trading town of Hoi An.

stops.name: Hanoi
stops.subtitle: Hanoi, Ninh Binh and the bay
stops.accom: 3 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 4★ · Four star hotel on the edge of the old quarter

activities.name: Ba Na Hills with the Golden Bridge
activities.match: Ba na Hills & Golden Hands Bridge Tour
activities.description: The cable car up to Ba Na, the bridge held up by two stone hands and the flower gardens of Le Jardin d'Amour before the flight north.

activities.name: Ninh Binh day tour
activities.description: South to Ninh Binh for a rowing boat through the flooded caves at Tam Coc and the limestone country around it.

activities.name: Halong Bay day cruise with Titop island
activities.match: Day cruise tour in Halong bay
activities.description: A full day on the bay by boat, with a climb to the viewpoint on Titop island and time on its beach.

program.name: Hanoi
program.description: Three nights in the capital, with Ba Na Hills on the way, a day in Ninh Binh and a full day cruise on Halong Bay.

expert.name: Riya
expert.quote: South to north with a group, four star hotels throughout and two flights so no day is spent on the road.
expert.tip: Climb Titop island on the cruise day. It is twenty minutes of steps and the best view of the bay you will get at sea level.

summary: A week south to north with a small group: two nights in Saigon with the city and the Cu Chi tunnels, the flight to Da Nang and an evening in Hoi An, Ba Na Hills and the Golden Bridge, then three nights in Hanoi with Ninh Binh and a full day cruise on Halong Bay.
included: Included: 6 nights at four star hotels with daily breakfast; two domestic flights; all coach travel and transfers; a half day Saigon sightseeing tour; the Cu Chi tunnels; a Hoi An walking tour with a river boat ride; the Ba Na Hills tour with the cable car and the flower gardens; a Ninh Binh day tour; a full day cruise on Halong Bay with Titop island.
not_included: Not included: international flights; Vietnam visa fees; lunches and dinners; travel insurance; personal expenses.
